fieldValues.title: Groups sit idle while their ready work waits in the backlog
fieldValues.statement: When a working group has budget left and the programme holds a mountain of grounded work in its domain, I want the group fed until its room is used. Today one programme-wide queue of six, filled in epic order, starves the groups: twenty items that pass every check wait in the backlog while the builders exit with nothing to take.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-27: vignette c1253e35 (srs-programme, Narrative explorations): all these groups should have a mountain of work available
